query: INSERT INTO field_values (field_id, account_id, envelope_id, recipient_id, value, value_sha256, set_at) SELECT f.id, f.account_id, f.envelope_id, f.recipient_id, $5, $6, $7 FROM fields f WHERE f.account_id = $1 AND f.id = $2 AND f.envelope_id = $3 AND f.recipient_id = $4 ON CONFLICT (account_id, field_id) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value, value_sha256 = EXCLUDED.value_sha256, set_at = EXCLUDED.set_at WHERE field_values.account_id = $1
